description: V0.8c recorded-decision replay, entry financial-pressure-credit: every completed live LLM run's recorded decisions (docs/benchmark/v08c-dev/eval/) submitted again through the protocol by llm-agent 3's replay mode, without any model, beside the three deterministic comparators (no action, greedy, conservative-v2), which run again as they did live. Deterministic: a rerun gives the same files. Run from the repository root.
seedPlan: The seeds of docs/benchmark/v08c-dev/eval.json, so that the recorded decisions belong to the runs.

external.description: llm-agent 3 in replay mode: qwen36-35b-a3b's recorded decisions from the V0.8c evaluation, entry financial-pressure-credit, one recording per seed; the memory, the prompt and every attempt's input are rebuilt and checked against their recorded SHA-256, and every validate answer is asked again and compared; no model is called
